description: This file defines the class 'FilterProcessResult' used in Drupal's filter module to encapsulate the result of text filtering, including processed text, cache metadata, and placeholder creation.

classes.name: FilterProcessResult
classes.description: A class representing the result of a text filter process, including processed text, cache metadata, and placeholder generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of FilterProcessResult with optional processed text.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the processed text as a string.

methods.name: createPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder markup for lazy loading, attaching it to the object, and returns the placeholder markup.
